about: Pattern catalog for slop_scan.py. Weights: single words 0.3-1.5, stock phrases ~2, structures/frames 2-3. Matching is per line, case-insensitive unless case_sensitive is true. Overlapping matches on one line keep only the highest weight. references/patterns.md is generated from this file by gen_patterns_md.py.

patterns.why: Rare in everyday prose but heavily over-used by chat models.
patterns.example: Let's delve into the details.

patterns.why: Decorative metaphor stretched over anything complicated.
patterns.instead: mix, range; or name the actual parts
patterns.example: The city is a rich tapestry of cultures.

patterns.why: Ceremonial phrasing that praises instead of showing.
patterns.instead: shows, proves; or state the evidence
patterns.example: The bridge stands as a testament to human ingenuity.

patterns.why: Figurative 'landscape' stands in for a field the writer never describes.
patterns.instead: market, field; or say what actually changed
patterns.example: Startups must adapt to the evolving landscape.
We help teams navigate the complexities of compliance.

patterns.why: Marketing adjective; rarely true and never specific.
patterns.example: Enjoy a seamless onboarding experience.

patterns.why: Corporate verb for 'use'. Fine as a finance term, which this pattern tries to skip.
patterns.example: We leverage AI to improve outcomes.

patterns.why: Promise without content: what exactly gets better?
patterns.example: This course will unlock your full potential.

patterns.instead: say what changed and by how much
patterns.example: Dark mode is a game-changer.
These tips will elevate your writing.

patterns.why: 'Robust' as generic praise. Correct technical uses (robust statistics, robust estimator) are not matched.
patterns.instead: reliable, well-tested; or give the failure case it handles
patterns.example: We built a robust framework for growth.
Our cutting-edge platform does it all.
Harness the power of data.
In the realm of software, change is constant.

patterns.why: Abstract nurturing verb attached to an abstract noun.
patterns.instead: build, encourage; or describe the practice
patterns.example: Retros foster a culture of trust.

patterns.instead: most important; or just say it first
patterns.example: Security is paramount.

patterns.why: Default positive adjective for places, communities and colors.
patterns.example: A vibrant community of makers.

patterns.instead: say who it convinced and why
patterns.example: This message will resonate with readers.
Before you embark on this project, plan ahead.

patterns.instead: process, path; or describe the steps
patterns.example: Wherever you are in your learning journey, start small.

patterns.instead: key, important; or explain the consequence
patterns.example: It was a pivotal moment for the company.
It offers unparalleled flexibility.

patterns.why: Formal verb chat models use for 'shows'.
patterns.example: This underscores the importance of testing.
The archive is a treasure trove of letters.
The library is a beacon of hope.
Her work leaves an enduring legacy.
It depends on a delicate interplay of heat and pressure.
In this ever-evolving field, keep learning.
We are at the forefront of innovation.

patterns.why: Praise word that skips the reason.
patterns.instead: say why it is worth it
patterns.example: Mentors are invaluable.

patterns.instead: core, main; or explain the dependency
patterns.example: Trust is the cornerstone of any team.

patterns.instead: a concrete detail the reader can picture
patterns.example: The view is breathtaking.
Get actionable insights from your data.
Today we take a deep dive into caching.

patterns.instead: improve, speed up; give a number
patterns.example: Supercharge your workflow with these tools.
Each detail was meticulously crafted.
The hotel sits in the heart of the old town.

patterns.why: Stock praise for any place or field.
patterns.instead: one real fact from that history
patterns.example: The town has a rich history.
The results were remarkable.

patterns.why: Intensifier that adds sincerity, not information.
patterns.example: It is truly a special place.

patterns.instead: say how one affects the other
patterns.example: Health and wealth are deeply intertwined.

patterns.why: Importance adjectives; individually harmless, slop in bulk.
patterns.example: Testing is crucial.

patterns.instead: delete it and state the point
patterns.example: It's important to note that results may vary.
Sleep plays a crucial role in memory.
This may potentially reduce costs.
When it comes to pricing, less is more.

patterns.instead: list two or three, or give the number
patterns.example: We offer a wide range of services.
The story serves as a powerful reminder of what matters.
The tower stands as a symbol of the city.

patterns.why: Fake depth marker before a plain definition.
patterns.example: At its core, the idea is simple.

patterns.why: Sentence-initial connective used as rhythm filler.
patterns.example: It is fast. Additionally, it is cheap.
Never underestimate the power of habit.
Small habits make a big difference.

patterns.why: Audience-widening clause that targets no one.
patterns.instead: pick the reader you are writing for
patterns.example: Whether you're a beginner, a hobbyist, or a pro, this guide is for you.
In today's fast-paced digital world, time is money.
In an era where attention is scarce, brevity wins.
In a world where everything is online, privacy matters.
Have you ever wondered why the sky is blue?
Imagine a world without passwords.
Let's face it, meetings are too long.
As an AI language model, I cannot browse the web.

patterns.regex: \b(?:in conclusion|in summary|to sum (?:it )?up|to summari[sz]e|to wrap (?:it|things) up|all in all|in a nutshell)\b
patterns.why: School-essay closer; the reader knows it's the end.
patterns.instead: end on the last real point
patterns.example: In conclusion, testing matters.

patterns.regex: (?:^|[.!?]\s+)(?:Ultimately|Overall|In the end|At the end of the day|In short),
patterns.why: Summary pivot that restates instead of adding.
patterns.instead: cut the recap or make it a new point
patterns.example: Ultimately, the choice is yours.
I hope this helps!

patterns.regex: \b(?:let me know if (?:you|there)|feel free to (?:ask|reach out|let me know|contact|share))\b
patterns.instead: delete it, or ask one specific question
patterns.example: Let me know if you have any questions.
Happy coding!

patterns.instead: end on the most useful step
patterns.example: By following these steps, you can stay safe.

patterns.regex: \b(?:the future (?:is|looks) (?:bright|promising|exciting)|the possibilities are (?:truly )?(?:endless|limitless)|only time will tell|the sky'?s the limit)\b
patterns.instead: end on a concrete next step or open question
patterns.example: The possibilities are endless.

patterns.regex: \b(?:stay tuned|stay safe out there|stay curious|keep exploring|keep learning|stay prepared)\b
patterns.example: Stay tuned for part two.

patterns.instead: delete it, or make the point once
patterns.example: Remember, consistency beats intensity.
Preparation is key!

patterns.regex: (?:\bagree\?|\bthoughts\?|\bwhat do you think\?|\bwhat(?:'s| is) your take\?|\bdrop (?:a|your) [\w ]{1,30} (?:in|below)|\blet me know in the comments|\brepost if|♻)
patterns.instead: ask a real, specific question or end
patterns.example: Agree? Let me know in the comments.

patterns.regex: \b(?:isn'?t|aren'?t|wasn'?t|is not|are not|was not|it'?s not|not) (?:just|merely|simply|only) (?:about )?[^.!?]{1,60}?[.,;—–-]\s*(?:it'?s|they'?re|it is|this is|that'?s|but)\b
patterns.why: The 'not just X, it's Y' frame: sets up a strawman to sound profound.
patterns.example: This isn't just a tool, it's a movement.

patterns.why: 'It's not about X, it's about Y' reframe.
patterns.example: It's not about speed. It's about trust.
Libraries are more than just books.

patterns.why: Formal correlative; normal English, but over-used in generated text.
patterns.example: It is not only faster but also cheaper.
The result? A 40% faster build.

patterns.instead: delete it and say the thing
patterns.example: But here's the thing: nobody reads the docs.
No fluff. No filler. Just results.

patterns.why: Praises the asker instead of answering.
patterns.example: Great question! Let me explain.

patterns.instead: say what specifically was right, or skip
patterns.example: You're absolutely right, I made a mistake.
Certainly! Here is the code.
I'd be happy to help with that.
I completely understand your frustration.
Let's dive in!
Let's break it down.

patterns.why: Announces a list instead of giving it.
patterns.example: Here's a quick breakdown of the options.
Here's everything you need to know.

patterns.regex: \bin this (?:article|post|blog post|guide|piece|tutorial|section),? (?:we|I)(?:'ll| will| are going to| am going to)\b
patterns.example: In this article, we'll cover the basics.
Let us take a closer look at the data.

patterns.why: Numbered-step template; fine for real procedures.
patterns.example: **Step 1: Install the CLI**
Learning is a journey, not a destination.

patterns.regex: \b(?:a (?:powerful|gentle|stark|poignant|timely|humbling) reminder|reminds us that|serves as a reminder)\b
patterns.example: It's a powerful reminder that we are all connected.
Focus on what truly matters.

patterns.regex: \b(?:in the end|at the end of the day|ultimately),? (?:it'?s|it is|life is|success is|everything is) (?:not )?(?:about|the)\b
patterns.example: In the end, it's about people.
The real magic happens when teams trust each other.

patterns.instead: accept, use; or say what to do
patterns.example: Embrace the uncertainty.
Sometimes, the simplest solution is the best.
That's the power of community.
You will fail sometimes, and that's okay.

patterns.regex: \b(?:one step at a time|the rest is history|only the beginning|just the beginning|stronger together|for generations to come|let that sink in)\b
patterns.example: Take it one step at a time.

patterns.why: Every bullet starts with a bold label and a colon: the house style of chat answers.
patterns.example: - **Speed:** Builds finish in seconds.

patterns.why: 'Label: explanation' bullets; normal in references, slop when every list is built this way.
patterns.instead: vary the list or use prose
patterns.example: - Speed: Builds finish in seconds.

patterns.why: Bold line used as a heading in a short answer.
patterns.instead: a sentence that leads into the section
patterns.example: **Why It Matters**

patterns.why: Three or more bold spans on one line: emphasis everywhere means emphasis nowhere.
patterns.example: Use **clear** names, **short** functions and **small** files.

patterns.why: Emoji as bullets or heading decorations.
patterns.example: 🚀 Launching today!
We shipped it 🎉
Thanks all! #AI #Leadership #Growth
→ Ship small changes
Period.

patterns.why: Faux-candid beat typical of generated 'casual' text.
patterns.example: And honestly? It changed everything.
There is a myriad of options.
A bustling market square.
A nuanced, multifaceted problem.

patterns.why: Corporate buzzwords that replace the actual mechanism.
patterns.instead: say who can now do what
patterns.example: We empower teams with holistic solutions.
A groundbreaking, transformative product.
The hotel boasts a rooftop pool.

patterns.instead: say who it fits / name the two benefits
patterns.example: Hybrid work offers the best of both worlds.

patterns.regex: \b(?:first and foremost|last but not least|without further ado|buckle up|grab a (?:coffee|cup)|strap in)\b
patterns.example: Without further ado, here are the results.

patterns.regex: ^\s*(?:#+\s*|\*\*)(?:key takeaways?|the bottom line|final thoughts|wrapping up|conclusion|in conclusion|summary|why (?:it|this|that) matters)\b
patterns.why: Template section headings in a short text.
patterns.instead: end on the last real point
patterns.example: ## Key Takeaways
